# MindMaster Academy

> Premier cognitive development, Superfast Vedic Maths, and Photographic Memory training institute in Satara, Maharashtra. Founded and led by renowned International Memory Coach Prashant Dhumal Sir.

MindMaster Academy empowers students, educators, and competitive exam aspirants with proven mental arithmetic, Vedic mathematics formulas, 500-year calendar calculation algorithms, and photographic memory techniques.

## Core Pages
- [Home Page](https://mindmasteredu.in/): Official overview, live statistics, video demonstrations, student testimonials, and demo booking.
- [About Prashant Dhumal & Academy](https://mindmasteredu.in/about): Biography of Prashant Dhumal Sir, awards, credentials, teaching philosophy, and media coverage.
- [Courses & Programs](https://mindmasteredu.in/courses): Comprehensive courses including Vedic Maths Foundation, Photographic Memory Mastery, Speed Maths, and Teacher Training.
- [Free Demo Session](https://mindmasteredu.in/demo): Interactive booking portal for parents and students to schedule live trial sessions.
- [Brain Games & Mental Gym](https://mindmasteredu.in/brain-games): Interactive cognitive exercises, speed calculation practice, and memory drills.
- [Student Results & Testimonials](https://mindmasteredu.in/results): Documented student speed records, national championship medals, and video parent reviews.
- [Official Contact & Location](https://mindmasteredu.in/contact): Academy contact details, WhatsApp inquiry (+91 84593 44077), and Satara center address.
- [Certificate Verification](https://mindmasteredu.in/verify-certificate): Public credential verification portal for validating authentic student course certificates.

## Learning Portal & Legal
- [MindMaster Learning Portal](https://app.mindmasteredu.in): Student and staff web application for enrolled courses, recorded video lessons, digital books, and progress tracking.
